title: Named accountability
description: Every active system must have a named accountable owner and a distinct risk owner or explicitly documented role arrangement.

title: Intended purpose and boundaries
description: An active system must document intended use, context, user groups and prohibited or out-of-scope uses.

title: No legal or certification claims
description: Tools and agents must never declare legal compliance, certification, regulatory classification or audit assurance solely from automated checks.

title: Evidence provenance
description: Every control verification must identify source, scope, timestamp, verifier and integrity reference; missing evidence is unknown, not pass.

title: Data minimization
description: Do not collect raw personal data, credentials, secrets, prompts containing confidential content or production records when metadata is sufficient.

title: Human decision authority
description: High-impact or consequential system decisions require documented human checkpoints and an authorized accountable decision-maker.

title: Version traceability
description: Model, tool, prompt, dataset and deployment versions must be recorded or explicitly marked unknown with an owner and review action.

title: Risk uncertainty is visible
description: Risk outputs must disclose assumptions, evidence gaps, confidence and factors; unknown must never be silently converted to low risk.

title: Least privilege and tool consent
description: Tool/plugin/MCP inventory must include permissions and consent boundaries; do not invoke or grant scopes without explicit authorization.

title: Lifecycle review and expiry
description: Active systems and exceptions must have review dates, expiry handling, change triggers and retirement/decommissioning evidence.
